### Comparison of the arms

Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. This comparison was run at the Harbor Street Patients.

Table 4. Results for each arm and measure, split by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Brostamide | Side effects | 66 | 400 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Cardivel | Side effects | 56 | 400 |

These values are listed for every arm and every subset.
